## History

Geraldine is a fictional character created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) within her writings. She is introduced as a character in a story that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes and discusses with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) while walking along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) around the time of Anne's thirteenth birthday.

### [Bertram](../character/bertram.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/bertram--geraldine.md)

Geraldine is saved by [Bertram](../character/bertram.md) within the fictional narrative written by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two characters are also romantically involved through an engagement in the story.
